create_ProtobufModel: create a ProtobufModel wrapper around a caffe2 protobuf net to run inference with torch.Tensor inputs and outputs
run_ProtobufModel_forward: run the ProtobufModel forward pass by feeding torch.Tensor inputs and returning tuple of torch.Tensor outputs
infer_ProtobufModel_output_devices: infer the output device types (cpu or cuda) for each caffe2 network output blob from input tensor devices
create_ProtobufDetectionModel: create a ProtobufDetectionModel that wraps ProtobufModel with batched input conversion and output format conversion for detection tasks
run_ProtobufDetectionModel_forward: run the ProtobufDetectionModel forward pass with batched inputs to get converted detection results
